turns.prompt:
Build the mail retry list from mail/worker-*.csv. For each message ID, use the row with the greatest UTC time, regardless of file or row order. A message keeps the same provider in all rows; times for a message are distinct. Select messages whose latest state is deferred and whose ID is absent from mail/suppressed.txt. Write summary.csv with header message,provider and rows sorted by message ID in ASCII order.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.
Also state the number of selected messages in your reply, using decimal digits.
Using only the summary.csv you just created, write report.txt with one provider=count line for each provider represented in that retry list. Sort providers in ASCII order; keep summary.csv unchanged.

turns.final: Created the requested report files. The retry list contains 4 messages.
